subject.title: fix: prevent empty Telegram sends for cron summaries

question: Should OpenClaw expose `fallbackText` and ordered `normalizePayloadBatch` as durable public channel-plugin SDK contracts to solve this Telegram cron-delivery edge case?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible, but accepting a new cross-plugin replacement and ordering contract is a product and SDK-boundary decision rather than a mechanical correction.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK contract
options.body: Accept the two public outbound adapter extensions and require current-head Telegram proof plus contract-level documentation and compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep the fix internal
options.body: Refactor the fallback and batch replacement data so only the cron and bundled Telegram implementation share it, avoiding a new external plugin API.

options.title: Pause for SDK design
options.body: Defer the PR until owners define whether batch replacement belongs in the stable channel adapter contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK contract
recommendation.body: Accept the two public outbound adapter extensions and require current-head Telegram proof plus contract-level documentation and compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Telegram outbound-normalization work is the closest established implementation boundary for deciding whether this new adapter contract belongs in the SDK.
